records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Blue Labs here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:d3f8fc4d] — no engagement signal at all. Pro plan suggests real intent, so some chance of self-serve start in the remaining 8 days, but silence dominates.

draft.subject: A hand getting Blue Labs' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a week. The usual first step is creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project set up for Blue Labs. Just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
Chidi
